Thanks Ben / Emma —

Attached is a consolidated redline of the Order Form (OrderForm_BRH_redline_20270913.docx). Summary of the material positions we propose and rationale:

1) Pricing schedule / staircase commits
   - We will accept a 3-tranche minimum commit with defined usage buckets and an annual true-up. Each tranche will be invoiced at the start of the tranche period; unused committed units are not refundable but may be reallocated across product SKUs (standard allowance).

2) Minimum commitments & proration
   - Commitments prorated to tranche start dates; early termination triggers prorated acceleration only for remaining committed units if Redwood exercises termination for convenience.

3) Net terms / invoicing cadence
   - Default Net30 in the MSA; for order-specific exceptions we can set Net45 on the Order Form. Finance will require a purchase order reference and a billing contact email on the PO. Invoices will be issued monthly per tranche unless parties agree otherwise.

4) Tax responsibility / VAT
   - Redwood will provide VAT-compliant invoices for EU billing entities where Redwood is required to charge VAT. For reverse-charge to apply, we need the customer's VAT registration number and a declaration in the Order Form. For US customers we require W-9 on file before sending taxable invoices.

5) PO and invoice routing
   - PO must reference Redwood contract ID: BRH-1972. Invoices will be sent to accounts-payable@blueriverhealth.com unless you provide a different AP address.

6) Docs and sign flow
   - We can accept PO attachment prior to DocuSign but require the executed Order Form (DocuSign) to flow to our billing system for invoice generation.

If any of these points are blockers please flag them; otherwise we'll produce a redline-ready DocuSign link and a short cover letter for procurement.

Regards,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Thanks for this overview — a few clarifying Qs from procurement after an internal review:

- On the VAT point: BlueRiver's EU subsidiary is VAT-registered (VAT ID GB123456789). If Redwood provides a VAT invoice, we will pay VAT where required; if reverse-charge is used, we will provide the VAT ID and a confirmation statement. Which option shortens the procurement cycle on your side?

- On PO acceptance: we typically send a PO as a separate document and request that the supplier reference it on the invoice. Is Redwood able to automatically match incoming PO numbers to invoices, or would manual mapping be required?

- Finally, we included our PO template for your ops team to verify (BRH-PO-Template.pdf). Can you confirm whether the "billing contact" field on the PO is mandatory for Redwood's AP system to process?

Emma —

Thanks for the quick follow-up. Short answers below and next steps so procurement can keep momentum: 

1) VAT path: Either option works operationally, but providing a VAT ID and electing reverse-charge typically reduces invoicing time for customers because Redwood does not need to register or apply VAT for that entity. If you opt for Redwood VAT invoices, we will issue them but need to confirm registration details for the billing entity. Please confirm preference; if reverse-charge please include VAT ID on the signed Order Form.

2) PO matching: Our AP system can match PO numbers to invoices automatically if the PO number is present in the invoice metadata. The billing contact field on the PO helps routing but the single mandatory data point is the PO number plus the Redwood contract ID (BRH-1972). Please have procurement include those two fields.

3) Billing contact: recommended but not strictly blocking — Kim (cc'd) can accept AP routing to accounts-payable@blueriverhealth.com and will set up any necessary manual routing exceptions.

Next steps (proposed timeline):
- Today (EOD): BlueRiver confirms VAT approach and returns PO template with contract ID filled.
- Tomorrow (9/15 AM): Redwood will generate DocuSign for the redlined Order Form and attach a short cover letter that documents invoicing cadence and the PO reference requirement.
- After execution: Redwood Finance will ingest the signed Order Form and confirm the first invoice date.

DocuSign link (will be live when we create the envelope): https://www.docusign.com/link/OfBRH1972

I'll keep this thread updated and will escalate to Finance ops if any further AP routing work is required.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
